headline: TPG: no trade. Results from before the open, summarized at night after a +7.4% session
reasoning: Filter gap: when Benzinga misses a pre-open release and carries only evening summaries, the filters think the results are new. A results headline after the close is now treated as released before that day's open when the day closed 5% or more from the prior close on 1.5x volume. Fixed after this run.
